q19.

MemoService is exposed through two protocols, both mounted on the same Echo HTTP server, and there is no native gRPC listener anywhere in the repo (`grpc.NewServer` never appears outside generated code).

**REST / HTTP+JSON (grpc-gateway) — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`**

The gateway mux is created with the auth middleware and `MemoService` is registered directly against the in-process service (no loopback dial), then the mux is wrapped into Echo under `/api/v1/*` and `/file/*`:

```108:129:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	if err := v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// ... other services ...
	handler := echo.WrapHandler(http.MaxBytesHandler(gwMux, maxAPIRequestBytes))

	gwGroup.Any("/api/v1/*", handler)
	gwGroup.Any("/file/*", handler)
```

The generated gateway code backing this is `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`.

**Connect RPC (connectrpc, used by the browser client in place of grpc-web) — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`**

`RegisterConnectHandlers` builds the Connect handler for MemoService and mounts it on a plain `http.ServeMux`:

```40:40:server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go
		wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)),
```

The receiver `s` is `ConnectServiceHandler`, which embeds `*APIV1Service` and adapts each gRPC method to Connect request/response wrappers in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (MemoService methods start around line 304). Interceptors and the Echo mount for the `/memos.api.v1.*` path prefix are also in `v1.go`:

```139:144:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	connectMux := http.NewServeMux()
	connectHandler := NewConnectServiceHandler(s)
	connectHandler.RegisterConnectHandlers(connectMux, connectInterceptors, connect.WithReadMaxBytes(maxAPIRequestBytes))

	connectGroup := echoServer.Group("")
	connectGroup.Any("/memos.api.v1.*", echo.WrapHandler(http.MaxBytesHandler(connectMux, maxAPIRequestBytes)))
```

The generated Connect stubs live in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`.

Summary in the requested format:

- REST/HTTP-JSON via grpc-gateway — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (generated: `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`)
- Connect RPC — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` plus `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` for the method wrapping, mounted in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (generated: `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`)
